# Command aliases

Every other spelling of a command, and the command it runs. An alias takes the same flags and prints the same output; the canonical command's page documents both.

| Alias | Runs |
|---|---|
| `lean-pkg lease` | [`lean-pkg claim`](claim.md#lean-pkg-claim) |
| `lean-pkg receipt local` | [`lean-pkg receipt systemd`](receipt.md#lean-pkg-receipt-systemd) |
